<!-- overview -->
This PR fixes numeric ordering in the TypeScript Hog VM's arraySort/arrayReverseSort by replacing the default string-based Array.prototype.sort with a comparator that orders numbers numerically and falls back to string comparison otherwise, plus a regression test. It is a pure-function change inside the sandboxed VM standard library with no new inputs, privileges, or external surfaces, and I found no security impact.
